DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今は昼の月を望遠鏡で見る催しをしています。ご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: We're holding an event to view the daytime moon through a telescope. Would you like to look?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見てみたいです。肉眼では月がどこにあるか見つけられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昼の月を見たいが位置が分からないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to. I can't find where the moon is with the naked eye.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to see the daytime moon but do not know where it is. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: あの木の上の白い点です。望遠鏡では大きく見えますが、台を動かさずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's the white dot above that tree. It looks bigger through the telescope, but please wait without moving the stand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 白い点が見えました。並んでいる間に、月の形の説明も読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 月を見つけ待機中に形の説明を読みたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can see the white dot. Can I also read the explanation of the moon's shape while I'm in line?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have found the moon and ask to read about its shape while waiting. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの札をご覧ください。今日は半分より少し欠けた形です。次がお客様の番です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please look at this sign. Today it is a little less than half full. It is your turn next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 覗く高さが合わないので、台を低くしてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 接眼部の高さ調整を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The viewing height doesn't suit me. Could you lower the stand?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the eyepiece height to be adjusted. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 係が高さを調整します。今なら接眼部を覗けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: A staff member will adjust the height. You can look through the eyepiece now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見えました。丸い穴のような影は、月の表面にあるものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 観察できた表面の影について質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can see it. Are the shadows that look like round holes on the moon's surface?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the shadows on the surface that you were able to observe. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その説明は観察担当がこの写真を使って行います。観察が済んだら、写真の机へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The observation staff will explain that using this photograph. When you're finished observing, please go to the table with the photographs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次の人に場所を譲ってから、机で説明を聞きます。月を見つけられてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次の観察者へ場所を譲り写真で説明を聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll give the next person my place, then listen to the explanation at the table. I'm glad I was able to find the moon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will give the next observer your place and listen to an explanation using photographs. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 写真の担当にも声をかけておきます。それでは、観察をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll let the photograph staff know too. Please enjoy observing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札内からのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking from inside the ticket gates, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が忘れた弁当を届けに来ています。私はもう改札へ入ったのですが、ここで受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入場後に家族が届けた弁当を受け取りたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've come to deliver the lunch a family member forgot. I've already gone through the ticket gate; can I receive it here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to receive the lunch delivered by your family after entering the gates. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お相手は改札の外にいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the other person outside the ticket gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。改札の脇に立っています。券を買って中へ来てもらう必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族が改札外にいると答え入場が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. They're standing beside the gate. Do they need to buy a ticket and come inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that your family member is outside the gates and ask whether entering is necessary. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この改札では、係員が立ち会って受け渡しをご案内できます。弁当以外の大きな物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: At this gate, staff can supervise and arrange a handover. Is there anything large besides the lunch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さな袋一つだけです。家族を呼んで、袋の中身を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受渡し物は小さな一袋と説明し家族を呼ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's just one small bag. I'll call my family member over and explain what's inside the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the handover is just one small bag and call your family member. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの受け渡し場所へ、お二人でお越しください。お客様は内側の線でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please both come to this handover point. You should wait at the line on the inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 内側へ移りました。弁当の袋はこちらです。私が受け取ったら、家族はそのまま帰れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定の内側で受け家族の帰り方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've moved to the inside. Here is the lunch bag. Once I receive it, can my family member go straight home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Receive it at the designated inside position and ask how your family member can leave. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。受け渡しが済みましたので、外のお相手はそのままお帰りいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The handover is complete, so the person outside can go straight home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。家族にお礼を言ってから、ホームへ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 弁当受領後に家族へ礼を伝えホームへ戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received it. I'll thank my family member and then return to the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After receiving the lunch, thank your family member and return to the platform. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 間に合ってよかったですね。それでは、お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad it made it in time. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の申請書をお持ちですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a certificate application form, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 学校と勤務先へ出すため、同じ証明書を二通取りたいです。申請書も二枚必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同種証明書二通の申請方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like two copies of the same certificate to submit to my school and workplace. Do I also need two application forms?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to apply for two copies of the same type of certificate. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要な種類が同じなら、この用紙の通数欄へ二通と書けます。提出先の指定は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: If the required type is the same, you can write two in the number-of-copies field on this form. Are the recipients' requirements the same?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 学校は世帯全員、勤務先は私一人の記載が必要と書いてあります。種類も分けるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先ごとの記載範囲の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says the school needs all household members listed, while my workplace needs only me listed. So I need to separate the types too, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference in the scope of information required by each recipient. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その指定でしたら、記載範囲を分けて担当へ伝えてください。提出先の案内もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: For those requirements, please tell the staff member the different scopes of information. Do you also have the recipients' instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二つとも持っています。それぞれの案内を横に置いて、一通ずつ記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二つの案内に合わせ一通ずつ申請すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have both. I'll put each set of instructions beside me and fill out an application for each copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will apply for one copy each according to the two sets of instructions. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分からない記載項目があれば、そのまま担当へご相談ください。今、迷っている所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: If there are any information fields you don't understand, please consult the staff member directly. Is there anything you're unsure about now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この番号を載せる欄です。学校の案内には指定がないので、発行前に担当へ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号の記載指定が不明で発行前に担当へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: This field for including the number. The school's instructions don't specify it, so I'd like to ask the staff member before it is issued.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the requirement to include the number is unclear and you will consult the staff member before issuance. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。こちらではまだ発行の確定をせず、必要な範囲を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll refer you to the staff member. We won't finalize issuance here yet; let's check the required scope first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。勤務先用と学校用の二枚に、提出先も書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提出先を記した二枚の申請を担当へ渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I've also written the recipients on the two forms, one for work and one for school.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand the staff member the two applications with their recipients written on them. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、二枚と案内を担当へお持ちください。ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take the two forms and instructions to the staff member. Thank you. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: これから採血のご案内です。袖を上げられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: We'll now guide you for your blood draw. Can you roll up your sleeve?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 肘の少し下までしか上がりません。厚い服を着てきてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 服の袖が肘まで上がらないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It only goes up to a little below my elbow. I came wearing thick clothing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your sleeve will not go up as far as your elbow. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袖を無理に引かなくて大丈夫です。上着の下は、どのような服ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You don't have to force the sleeve up. What are you wearing under your outer layer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 半袖のシャツです。人が通る場所で上着を脱ぐのは困るので、着替えられる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 半袖の上に上着を着ており脱ぐ場所を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: A short-sleeved shirt. I don't feel comfortable taking off my outer layer where people pass by. Is there somewhere I can change?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have an outer layer over a short-sleeved shirt and ask for a place to remove it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 奥の仕切りのある場所へご案内します。上着はそこで脱いで、かごへ置けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll show you to the partitioned area at the back. You can take off your outer layer there and put it in a basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこで脱ぎます。採血が終わった後も、その場所で上着を着られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 終了後も仕切りの中で着られるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll take it off there. Can I put my outer layer back on in that place after the blood draw too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can also put your clothes on inside the partition after finishing. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。腕の状態を担当が見てからお戻りいただきます。荷物もかごへ入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. You can return there after the staff member checks your arm. Will you put your belongings in the basket too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小さなかばんも入れます。財布はかばんの中にあるので、かごを自分の席の脇へ置きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: かばんを入れたかごを席の脇に置きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put my small bag in too. My wallet is in the bag, so I'd like to place the basket beside my seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to place the basket containing your bag beside your seat. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: かごはこちらへ置けます。準備ができたら、担当の看護師へお声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can put the basket here. When you're ready, please tell the nurse in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 上着を脱げました。半袖になったので、担当の方を呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 上着を脱いで採血担当を呼ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've managed to take off my outer layer. I'm in short sleeves now, so I'll call the staff member in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Remove your outer layer and call the blood-draw staff member. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらの席へどうぞ。準備ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take this seat. Thank you for getting ready. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 落とし物の届出ですね。何をなくされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're reporting a lost item. What did you lose?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自宅の鍵です。小さな銀色の鍵一本で、赤い輪が付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鍵一本の色と赤い輪を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My house key. It's one small silver key with a red ring attached.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the color of the single key and its red ring. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 落としたと思う時間と場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me when and where you think you lost it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 午前中に駅から市場まで歩きました。市場で財布を出したときには、鍵がありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紛失の時間帯と歩いた経路を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I walked from the station to the market in the morning. When I took out my wallet at the market, the key was missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the time period of the loss and the route you walked. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 鍵の形を描けますか。住所などが書かれた札は付いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you draw the key's shape? Is there a tag with an address or anything written on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 札はありません。ここに鍵と赤い輪の形を描きます。輪は一か所切れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 札の有無と切れた輪の特徴を絵で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is no tag. I'll draw the shapes of the key and red ring here. The ring is broken at one point.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain whether there is a tag and show the broken ring's feature in a drawing. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その特徴も記録します。届出を受けた番号はこちらです。ご自宅へ入る方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record that feature too. Here is the number for your report. Do you have a way to get into your home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予備の鍵を持っている家族へ連絡済みです。今日は帰れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予備鍵の家族に連絡済みで帰宅可能と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've already contacted a family member who has a spare key. I can get home today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have contacted the family member with a spare key and can get home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見つかった物が本人の物か確かめるため、連絡時には届出の内容を伺うことがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: To check whether a found item belongs to you, we may ask about the details of your report when we contact you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。番号の控えと、描いた特徴を手元に残しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 届出番号と特徴の控えを保管すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll keep a copy of the number and the features I drew with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep a copy of the report number and identifying features. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 届出を受け付けました。お気をつけてお帰りください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your report has been accepted. Take care on your way home. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご不在になる間の郵便について、お問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about your mail while you are away?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族全員で旅行します。留守の間、郵便受けへたまらないようにする方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族全員の旅行中に郵便受けへ郵便をためない方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My whole family is going on a trip. Is there a way to keep mail from piling up in the mailbox while we're away?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to prevent mail piling up in the mailbox while the whole family is traveling. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 不在届について担当がご案内します。ご不在の期間はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The staff member will explain the absence notice. Have you decided how long you will be away?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 来月の三日から十日までです。九日の夜に帰るので、十日から受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 出発三日と帰宅九日夜と十日受取希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: From the third to the tenth of next month. We'll return on the evening of the ninth, so I'd like to receive mail from the tenth.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State departure on the third, return on the evening of the ninth and the wish to receive mail from the tenth. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出発日と、配達を再開してほしい日を分けて担当へお伝えください。届出の用紙はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the staff member your departure date and desired delivery-resumption date separately. Here is the notification form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三日から九日までの保管を希望と書きます。この欄は同居の家族も含むのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三日から九日保管希望を記入し同居家族欄を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll write that I'd like mail held from the third through the ninth. This field includes family members living with me too, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Write a request for holding mail from the third through the ninth and check the field for cohabiting family members. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この届出で対象になる郵便の範囲は、担当がご説明します。住所を示す資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will explain which mail this notice covers. Do you have a document showing your address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持っています。荷物も全部同じ扱いになるかを、担当へ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住所資料を示し荷物も対象か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do. I'd like to ask the staff member whether all parcels are treated the same way too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the address document and ask whether parcels are covered too. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お荷物の種類で確認が必要です。旅行前に手続きできる時期もご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We need to check depending on the type of parcel. Please also discuss when you can complete the procedure before your trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所の資料と日程を出します。対象になる物と手続きの時期を聞いてから、不在届を提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象範囲と受付時期を確認後に不在届を提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll provide my address document and schedule. I'll submit the absence notice after asking what is covered and when the procedure can be done.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will submit the absence notice after checking its scope and application period. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll show you to the staff member. Thank you for consulting us. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 積立のご相談を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll hear your question about regular savings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給与日が変わったので、積立の引落日を後ろへずらしたいです。今は給与より先に引かれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与日の変更で積立引落しが先になると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My payday has changed, so I'd like to move the savings debit date later. Right now it is taken before my salary arrives.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a payday change means the savings debit now comes first. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 積立の種類が分かる通帳か控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a passbook or receipt showing the type of savings plan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この控えです。給与は毎月二十五日になります。引落しは今、二十日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 積立控えと給与日二十五日と現引落日二十日を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is the receipt. My salary will be paid on the twenty-fifth of every month. The debit is currently on the twentieth.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the savings receipt and state payday on the twenty-fifth and the current debit on the twentieth. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更できる日と、反映される月を担当が確認します。金額も変えたいご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check which dates are available for changing and which month it would take effect. Would you also like to change the amount?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金額はそのままです。日付だけ二十五日より後にできれば助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 積立額を維持し日付のみ後ろへ変えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The amount will stay the same. It would help if only the date could be changed to after the twenty-fifth.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to keep the savings amount and move only the date later. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当への相談票には、日付の変更のみと記入します。今月の引落しについても相談されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll write 'date change only' on the consultation form for the staff member. Will you also ask about this month's debit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。変更が今月に間に合わなければ、今の口座に必要な額を置いておくつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今月の反映可否を相談し未反映なら残高を確保すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If the change isn't in time for this month, I intend to keep the required amount in the current account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether it can take effect this month and say you will ensure sufficient funds if it cannot. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点も担当へお伝えします。現在の契約を続けるご意向ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the staff member that too. You intend to continue your current contract, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 続けたいです。選べる日を聞いてから日付を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 契約継続の意向と選択可能日を聞いて決める方針を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like to continue. I'll decide on the date after asking which dates I can choose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State your wish to continue the contract and your plan to decide after hearing the available dates. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 相談票を担当へお渡しください。それでは、ご案内いたします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please give the consultation form to the staff member. I'll show you the way. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 牛乳についてお尋ねでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。紙パックの口をうまく開けられません。ねじるふたの付いた容器はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紙パックを開けにくくねじぶた容器を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I can't open the spout of a paper carton very well. Do you have a container with a screw cap?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say paper cartons are hard to open and look for a screw-cap container. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この商品にはねじぶたがあります。容量は、いつもの紙パックより小さくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This product has a screw cap. It holds less than your usual paper carton.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一度に飲む量は少ないので、小さくて大丈夫です。ふたの開け方は絵にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小容量でよく開け方の図を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I drink only a little at a time, so a smaller one is fine. Is there a picture showing how to open the cap?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say a smaller capacity is fine and ask for an opening diagram. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 容器の側面にあります。最初は輪が切れるまで回す説明です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: It's on the side of the container. It explains to turn it until the ring breaks the first time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この絵なら分かります。冷蔵庫に立てて置く高さも知りたいので、今の紙パックと並べてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 容器の高さを紙パックと比較したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can understand this picture. I'd also like to know the height for standing it in the refrigerator, so may I put it beside my current paper carton?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to compare the container's height with the paper carton. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの台で比べられます。高さはほぼ同じですが、底の形が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can compare them on this counter. They are almost the same height, but their bases are different shapes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 高さは入れられそうです。底が丸いので、冷蔵庫の棚に置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 高さが合い丸い底を踏まえ棚へ置くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The height looks like it will fit. Since the base is round, I'll put it on a shelf in the refrigerator.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the height fits and you will place it on a shelf considering its round base. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日は、ねじぶたの商品を一本お選びになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will you choose one bottle of the screw-cap product today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。一本試して、開けやすければ次もこれを買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ねじぶた一本を試す購入を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll try one, and if it's easy to open, I'll buy this again next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to buy one screw-cap bottle to try. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、冷たい商品のままレジへお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take it to the checkout while it is still cold. Thank you very much.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 写生会の絵は描き終わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished your picture for the sketching event?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 描き終わりましたが、水彩絵の具がまだぬれています。紙を重ねて持つと色が付きそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ぬれた水彩画を重ねずに持帰りたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've finished drawing, but the watercolor paint is still wet. If I carry the sheets stacked together, the color looks likely to transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to take a wet watercolor home without stacking it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乾かすためのラックを用意しています。お名前は紙の裏へ書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have a rack for drying. Have you written your name on the back of the paper?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。表を触らずに裏へ名前を書くには、どこを持てばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 裏へ名前を書きたいが表を触らない持ち方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. Where should I hold it to write my name on the back without touching the front?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to write your name on the back and ask how to hold it without touching the front. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乾いた端を持って、こちらの板の上で裏返してください。名前を書けたらラックへ載せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hold a dry edge and turn it over on this board. After you've written your name, we'll put it on the rack.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前を書きました。絵を載せる段は空いている一番上でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記名を済ませ空いたラックの段を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've written my name. May I put the picture on the topmost available level?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have written your name and ask about an empty level on the rack. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。その段へ一枚だけ載せてください。帰るまで、どのくらいありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Put just one sheet on that level. How long is it until you leave?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あと二十分です。その間、ほかの人の絵を見ていてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰宅まで二十分あり他作品を見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Twenty more minutes. May I look at other people's pictures during that time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have twenty minutes before leaving and ask to view the other works. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 展示の列をご覧いただけます。お帰りの前に、乾き具合を一緒に見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can look at the display row. Before you leave, let's check together how dry it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では展示を見ます。帰るときにこの段へ戻って、持ち帰り方を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 展示後に乾き具合と持帰り方を相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll look at the display. When I leave, I'll return to this level and ask about how to carry it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after viewing the display you will discuss dryness and how to take the picture home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 絵はこの段に置いておきます。それでは、展示もお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll leave the picture on this level. Please enjoy the display too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その自転車を列車へお持ち込みの予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to take that bicycle onto the train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。折り畳んだので、このまま持って乗れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 折畳み自転車を裸のまま持込めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I've folded it, so can I take it aboard as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can bring a folded bicycle aboard uncovered. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 折り畳むだけでなく、専用の袋へ全体を収める条件があります。袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Besides folding it, you must put the whole bicycle inside a designated bag. Do you have a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋はありますが、サドルが上から出ています。全部を入れる必要があるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: サドルが袋から出ている状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a bag, but the saddle is sticking out at the top. So everything needs to be inside, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the saddle sticking out of the bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。通路を空けたこちらの場所で、袋へ収め直していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. You can repack it in the bag in this area, clear of the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらへ移ります。サドルを下げて袋を閉めるので、少し時間がかかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定場所でサドルを下げて袋を閉じ直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll move here. I'll lower the saddle and close the bag, so it will take a little time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will lower the saddle and reclose the bag in the designated area. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次の列車に間に合わなくても、袋の準備を終えてからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even if you miss the next train, we'll guide you after you've finished preparing the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋を閉められました。持ち上げるための取っ手は外に出してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 全体収納を終え取っ手を外へ出せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've managed to close the bag. May the handles for lifting it remain outside?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the whole bicycle is packed and ask whether the handles can remain outside. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 取っ手は持って運ぶために使えます。この状態を担当にも見てもらいましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can use the handles to carry it. Let's also have the staff member check it in this state.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。自転車を押してホームへ進まず、袋の取っ手で持って移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後は押さず袋を持ち運ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I won't push the bicycle along to the platform; I'll move it by carrying the bag's handles.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after the check you will carry the bag rather than push the bicycle. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当がこちらへ参ります。それでは、準備が済んでからお気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff member will come here. Once you're ready, please board carefully.
